content: If you look into your own heart, and you find nothing wrong there, what is there to worry about? What is there to fear?
author: Confucius
explanation: A clean conscience is the ultimate shield against fear and anxiety. When your motives are pure and your deeds honorable, external threats and rumors lose their power to wound your soul.
practicalInsight: Conduct a quiet nightly conscience review: if your intentions were pure, sleep in total serenity.
reflectionPrompt: How can maintaining spotless ethical integrity liberate you from chronic social anxiety?
